notes: Core game rules. Distances in game units (~1 m), time in seconds. A number in a per-level list is the value for that level.

match.winCondition: A team loses when it has no Town Hall (any tier) left. The last team with a Town Hall wins.

heroBase.abilityLevelRule: Basic ability level N needs hero level 2N-1 (levels 1, 3, 5). Ultimate needs hero level 6 and has 1 level.

experience.shareRule: XP is split equally between allied heroes in range. The killer does not need to be a hero.

gold.lastHitRule: The unit that lands the killing blow gets the full bounty. Allied heroes in range get assistShare of it, split between them.

respawn.location: heroSpawn of the player's start, or the nearest own Town Hall if the main one is gone

combat.armorFormula: reduction = 0.06 * armor / (1 + 0.06 * armor). Negative armor makes damage bigger: factor = 2 - 0.94^(-armor).
combat.spellDamage: Spell damage ignores armor and armor types. Heroes take 75% spell damage. Spells do not hurt buildings unless the ability says so.

airLayers.ground: Normal units. Blocked by trees, water, cliffs and buildings.
airLayers.lowAir: Flies over everything but can be attacked by melee and ranged. Used by the Sky Dragon.
airLayers.air: Flies over everything. Melee attacks can not reach it. Used by Hawk Riders and Harpies.

damageTable.notes: Multiplier of attack damage. Rows are attack types, columns are armor types.

crowdControl.stun: Can not move, attack or cast.
crowdControl.root: Can not move. Can attack and cast.
crowdControl.silence: Can not cast. Can move and attack.
crowdControl.slow: Less move speed (and attack speed if the ability says so). Slows do not stack; the strongest one counts.
crowdControl.knockback: Pushed along the ground, stops at cliffs, trees and buildings.
crowdControl.stackRule: The same buff from the same source refreshes its time. Different buffs stack.

neutrals.dropRule: One roll on the camp's drop table when the last monster of the camp dies. The item falls where that monster died.

items.notes: Items on the ground (camp drops and dropped items) vanish after groundItemSec. A hero walks to an item to pick it up, and to an ally to give one.

fountain.affects: Heroes and faction units of every team. Not neutral monsters.

sight.blockers: Trees and higher ground block sight. Units on high ground see low ground.

notes: The hero hires soldiers with hero gold at one of its own finished production buildings (any unit that building trains, with the same faction tech).
Price = (unit gold + unit wood) x priceFactor. Hired soldiers use no faction supply; a hero can have soldiers of at most maxSupply supply.
Soldiers follow the hero (a spot within followDistance) and choose their own targets. They leave a fight only when it is more than leash from the hero.
When the hero is dead they walk to its respawn point and wait. Town Hall upgrades work on them like on the army.
